GitHub 搜索可用（Postiz 单个 repo 403 是限流）。抓 Postiz 官网定价，同时看后台进度。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const fs=require('fs');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const u of ['https://postiz.com/pricing','https://postiz.com/']){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(u);",
 " console.log('=== '+u+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
 " let s=r.body.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " // 找价格",
 " const prices=[...s.matchAll(/\\$(\\d+)/g)].map(function(m){return m[1]});",
 " console.log(' prices found:', JSON.stringify([...new Set(prices)].slice(0,20)));",
 " const idx=s.indexOf('Standard');",
 " console.log(' sample:', s.substring(idx>0?idx-200:0, (idx>0?idx-200:0)+1200));",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
 " }",
 " // 检查 pains 后台任务进度",
 " try{ const p=fs.readFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt','utf8'); console.log('\\n=== PAINS JOB LEN:', p.length, 'DONE:', p.includes('DONE')); }catch(e){ console.log('\\npains not ready'); }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pz2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pz2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Postiz pricing and check job", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const fs=require('fs');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'text/html'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  for(const u of ['https://postiz.com/pricing','https://postiz.com/']){",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get(u);",
  "      console.log('=== '+u+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length);",
  "      let s=r.body.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      // 找价格",
  "      const prices=[...s.matchAll(/\\$(\\d+)/g)].map(function(m){return m[1]});",
  "      console.log('  prices found:', JSON.stringify([...new Set(prices)].slice(0,20)));",
  "      const idx=s.indexOf('Standard');",
  "      console.log('  sample:', s.substring(idx>0?idx-200:0, (idx>0?idx-200:0)+1200));",
  "    }catch(e){ console.log(u+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,4000)});",
  "  }",
  "  // 检查 pains 后台任务进度",
  "  try{ const p=fs.readFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt','utf8'); console.log('\\n=== PAINS JOB LEN:', p.length, 'DONE:', p.includes('DONE')); }catch(e){ console.log('\\npains not ready'); }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pz2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pz2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Postiz pricing and check job", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
